purpose: Additional human conversation review; separate from the unchanged 211-case objective grader
rubric: Asks only for genuinely missing information
Distinguishes proposed plans from saved actions
Respects fixed events and time constraints

turns: pon gym mañana a las 10 AM
no quiero estudiar después de las 8 PM
conversations.review: Apply and verify the real client receipt between turns. Changing the hour must edit the same event. A reminder lacking an alert time must not invent one. Planning respects the final cutoff.

conversations.context: Run once with an empty agenda and once with actual synthetic pending tasks and deadlines.
conversations.review: Acknowledge briefly and help choose a concrete next step using available context. Do not invent obligations or turn emotional disclosure into a task.

turns: quiero avanzar con Focus pero también ir al gym
conversations.review: Offer an achievable division as a proposal. Identify missing commute/duration assumptions instead of asserting a saved schedule.

turns: Hilante, mañana quiero avanzar tres horas con Focus, ir al gym y tengo fútbol a las 8 PM. Organízame el día pero no quiero levantarme antes de las 9 AM.
conversations.review: Consult supplied agenda, preserve football at 20:00, allocate three hours to Focus, schedule nothing before 09:00 and propose uncertain durations for review. Never claim persisted changes until a receipt exists.

turns: Organízame toda la semana considerando universidad, gimnasio, Focus, mis pendientes, horas de sueño y que quiero dejar viernes y sábado por la noche libres. Si ves que no alcanza el tiempo, prioriza por importancia y explícame qué moverías.
conversations.review: Use relevant synthetic events and preferences, protect Friday/Saturday evenings including overlapping blocks, preserve fixed commitments and explain any assumptions or unsatisfied goals. A higher tier does not confer permission to invent commitments.
